design.steps: For each operation pair, observe contested PG lock and both orders: restriction before publication, publication before restriction. Repeat with session/member expiry after wait; crash before/after tombstone transaction; duplicate delete
design.oracle: Restriction-first prevents mutation/disclosure; publication-first is followed by durable invalidation. Tombstones monotonic, no resurrection or deadlock-induced success. Uncertain lock timeout reports unknown/denial. Partial transaction rolls back atomically; pending jobs survive committed tombstone.
